method.status: Numerically compatible hypothesis; the new review supplies no executable formula or explicit scope/rounding rule.
method.mainScope: All four whole unit variants; no dialogues, catalogue, model, slot or phonetic field.
method.ratio: |distinct types at level minus union of all previous levels| / |distinct types at level|.
method.latin: re.findall(r'[^\W\d_]+', study.lower(), re.UNICODE); surface letter groups, apostrophe/hyphen boundaries.
method.cjk: For zh/ja/ko, individual Unicode letters/numbers; Hangul syllables in ko, not the legacy word blocks.
method.rounding: Compare exact rational ratios and separately ROUND_HALF_UP integer percentages; no intermediate rounding.
method.legacyScope: Original mesure_briques.py: variants plus dialogue turns; zh/ja U+3040–U+9FFF characters, ko Hangul word blocks, Latin letter groups.
method.dialogueScenario: For sensitivity only, unreclassified dialogues remain at their source level. This is not a proposed integrated dialogue route.
method.providerCounts: A new type appearing in several units is counted once at level and once in each provider; provider counts are not additive.
method.limits: Distinct surface forms are not meanings, structural operations, comprehension or observed mastery. Tokens differ between scripts; do not rank languages. Within-level order is ignored.
